    bl=[];cur=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        if any(v!=bg for v in row): cur.append(r)

    s=min(range(-(w-1),w), key=lambda s:(mism(s),abs(s)))
    mx1=max(c for c,v in enumerate(g1) if v!=bg)
